build_roi_pool_module: build a RoIPool module with a given output size and spatial scale for region of interest pooling
run_roi_pool_function: run the roi_pool function on input features and RoI coordinates to extract pooled regions
test_RoIPoolFunction_forward: test the RoIPoolFunction forward pass with input tensor and RoI boxes of shape (N, 5)
review_RoIPool_backward: review the RoIPoolFunction backward pass that computes gradients using saved argmax indices
refactor_RoIPool_repr: refactor the RoIPool class __repr__ method to customize the string representation of output size and spatial scale
